graph.name: Recall an offscreen plan · Post
graph.description:
Use a selected actor's saved plans and episodes to suggest a possible return to the visible scene.

Lesson: Recall can connect saved actor episodes to a present scene without promoting an offscreen possibility to fact. A separate Post companion internalizes only settled evidence and commits at the root.

Limitations: Actor-scoped recollection can motivate a beat; no global world simulation, scheduled timers, or arbitrary multi-actor storage exists.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Writes actor memory on full Run. Inspect local update and save acknowledgment separately; unconfirmed saving is not durable saving.

Try changing:
Change the delivery suggestion from Rin returning in person to a supplied messenger arriving; inspect whether the proposed news is still labeled unconfirmed.
Run to Internalize before a full Post Run; compare the proposal preview with the Memory Commit Host diagnostic and its separate save acknowledgment.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Remembered plan: Rin left to ask the ferry keeper about the missing boat.

Possible return: If supported by settled evidence, Rin can return with news. Treat an unconfirmed outcome as a possibility, not a fact.

Pre sources and interpretation: Keep both Memory readers in the root. Wire scene→Reflect context, state→Reflect/Express state, episodes→Reflect/Express episodes, Reflect→Express assessment, scene→Express context, then Express→Guidance.

Post companion: evidence → proposal → settlement: Wire Post State+Events→Internalize→Commit in a separate Post root workflow. Only a successful full root Run can settle; Run to here, preview, failed runs and imported fixture prose do not seed memory.

Local setup: Analysis bindings remain unresolved. This actor-scoped example needs real supported saved records for its memory demo; it is neither a global agenda store nor an automatic world scheduler.

Agenda before update (post-state)
Purpose: Read the current actor-state snapshot as the prior version for the companion's proposal.
Inspect: Confirm Rin is still selected and inspect the current store version. This root source and Settled return evidence must describe the same actor/chat/store.

Settled return evidence (post-events)
Purpose: Read Events Data from supported settled host messages after the scene actually supplies a return or news.
Fixture: Post demo prerequisite: a supported settled message states: Rin returned and reported, 'The ferry keeper has not seen the missing boat.' Use the actual host event IDs/revisions; no fixture writes or fabricates records.
Inspect: Check actual event IDs and revisions and that the return occurred. Internalize requires at least one settled event; an ungenerated Pre suggestion is insufficient.

Record what Rin learned (post-internalize)
Purpose: Propose supported agenda/history updates from prior State and settled Events, without persisting them yet.
Inspect: Run to here to inspect state-proposal changes and each sourceRef. A proposal preview is not a memory write.

Settle Rin's agenda update (post-commit)
Purpose: Terminate the successful full Post root Run with one scoped compare-and-swap memory settlement.
Inspect: Inspect the Commit Host diagnostic. The default key derives from this exact transaction. Full Post Run may write without a review-click; report local update and save acknowledgment separately.

post-internalize.title: Internalize · experience
post-internalize.instructions: Update Rin only from the supplied settled inquiry/return events. Record the ferry keeper's reported lack of sighting if actually present, retain the missing-boat goal as unresolved, and distinguish a reported claim from verified boat location. Add a supported episode or temporary condition only with exact supplied event IDs and revisions. Do not mark the search complete, simulate other actors, change enduring traits, or overwrite unrelated state. Leave numeric values, curves and tracks unchanged.
